name: Gahz'rilla's Icicle and Jammal'an's mana pool let their spells go out (#7380)
contract: Gahz'rilla (7273) is unit_class 1 and has no mana; its Ascension kit row 9000 casts Icicle (11131, 135 mana) and every cast failed with NO_POWER. The kit cast is now triggered, so Icicle goes out without mana.
Jammal'an the Prophet (5710), raised to level 54, had 2041 mana against Healing Wave 835 + Flamestrike 1207; ManaModifier 2 gives 4082.

steps.label: Jammal'an holds Healing Wave plus Flamestrike at level 54
Gahz'rilla's kit Icicle goes out (first cast 6-8 s into combat)
